title: parse_addresses stub treats entire From header as one raw address
description: mail/src/email/types.rs:195-199: parse_addresses() returns vec\![EmailAddress { name: None, email: raw.to_string() }] — it wraps the entire raw header value as a single email string without any parsing. A From: header with display name (Alice <alice@example.com>) stores 'Alice <alice@example.com>' as the email field. Multi-address From headers store the whole comma-separated list as one email. Any JMAP client querying email.from will see garbage. The comment says 'Full RFC 5322 parsing is deferred' but there is no tracking issue and the function is exported as a public API. → A contributor could add features that depend on email.from and never notice the values are wrong. Fix: either use the mailparse or email_address crate, or at minimum return the angle-bracket content when present.
